question: Sangeet Kala Acharya Award is given by which organisation every year since 1993?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madras Music Academy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Sangeet Kala Acharya Award is given by the **Madras Music Academy**, which is one of the oldest and most prestigious music academies in India.
 
• This award has been conferred annually since **1993**.
 
• The award is given to individuals who have made significant contributions to the field of music and dance.
